title: IoT-Enabled Autonomous Maritime Navigation in Smart Ports: A Curriculum-Guided Shared Policy Learning Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.11597v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As smart port infrastructures increasingly rely on autonomous maritime devices enabled by the Internet of Things (IoT), ensuring reliable onboard navigation intelligence has become a critical challenge for safe and scalable operations in congested waterways. This paper investigates onboard autonomous navigation for such IoT devices under partial observability and dense traffic conditions. A curriculum-guided reinforcement learning framework with a shared recurrent policy is developed to enhance temporal reasoning, deployment scalability, and robustness of edge-level decision-making. Centralized training is adopted as an offline design-time strategy, while all navigation actions are executed fully onboard, consistent with IoT edge intelligence paradigms. Extensive simulations in multiple realistic port environments demonstrate that the proposed approach improves navigation reliability, collision avoidance, and training stability compare

translated_title: 面向智能港口的物联网自主航海导航：一种课程引导的共享策略学习框架
translated_abstract: 随着智能港口基础设施日益依赖由物联网（IoT）赋能的自主航海设备，确保可靠的车载导航智能已成为在拥挤水道中实现安全、可扩展运营的关键挑战。本文研究了在部分可观测性和密集交通条件下，此类物联网设备的车载自主导航问题。我们开发了一种课程引导的强化学习框架，并采用共享循环策略，以增强时序推理能力、部署可扩展性以及边缘级决策的鲁棒性。集中训练被用作离线设计阶段的策略，而所有导航操作均在完全车载的条件下执行，这与物联网边缘智能范式相一致。在多个真实港口环境中的广泛模拟表明，所提出的方法在导航可靠性、避碰能力和训练稳定性方面均有所提升。
tldr: 本文提出了一种课程引导的共享循环策略强化学习框架，用于在部分可观测和密集交通条件下实现物联网自主航海设备的可靠车载导航，并通过集中训练与边缘执行相结合的方式提升了导航性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a curriculum-guided shared recurrent policy reinforcement learning framework for reliable onboard IoT-enabled autonomous maritime navigation under partial observability and dense traffic, combining centralized training with edge-level execution.
